export.applicability: document id is unique only within its owner; different owners may use the same id

archive.stores: JSON-serializable records; reopen preserves supplied bytes, not fields the integration drops

composition.buildArchive: synchronous buildArchive(items) returns JSON-serializable records preserving owner, id and payload
composition.lookup: synchronous lookup(archive, {owner,id}) returns exactly that record or null
composition.invalidQuery: missing or empty owner/id returns null
composition.aggregation: one archive can contain multiple owners with equal document ids, without collisions
composition.closedChildren: consume fixed public outputs; do not change export or archive releases
